question: How many nine-dart finishes will there be in the 2026 Grand Slam of Darts?

calls.reasoning: Grand Slam history 2007-2025: 7 nine-darters in 19 editions (2008, 2014, 2015, 2018, 2022, 2023, 2025), never more than one per edition -> ~0.37 per edition; recent era 3 of last 4 editions had one, and the 2025 televised nine-darter rate was elevated. The 2026 expansion to 48 players (16 groups of 3) keeps 48 group matches and probably a 16-player knockout, so total legs are roughly unchanged but the field is diluted with lower-tier qualifiers. Poisson lambda ~0.55 blending the long-run and recent rates. No human market found (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi, bookmakers: none found for this event); a World Grand Prix nine-darter Yes price of 14/1 seen in a search snippet is a near-miss contract only.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: 7 nine-darters in 19 editions, never 2+, and the 2026 format keeps the 48 group matches and 63 total. Run 3's dartrankings source gives KO lengths of Bo19 for the last 16 and Bo31 for the QF, consistent with the old format; the others left this unconfirmed but it barely changes leg volume. The only real difference is lambda (0.55-0.65), which is a judgment call. I took about 0.65 because the 2025-2026 televised nine-darter rate is elevated (Run 2's evidence), partly offset by field dilution. No market found by any run; no web access on this run.
